scope: 41 resolved castle Sieges in three available saved games; one Pillage excluded. Both players; older policies differ.

method.cards: COMBAT_ORDER_SEALED.order.card_ids count; card strength is total strength minus Supplicants
method.castle_damage: SIEGE_RESOLVED.damage + BASTION_SCREENED.damage matched by round and attacking player
method.repairs: Positive before/after gains from WORK_RESOLVED with passive=0 and reconstruction=false, plus FORGE_REPAIR/RAPID_CONSTRUCTION; construction excluded.
